title: Add typed-tool-contract RAG playbook and golden-path smoke harness
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Introduces a new quickstart that demonstrates typed tool contracts for RAG tool-chaining and includes a golden-path smoke harness (playbook + CI) for reproducible authoring and local replay.
description:
Motivation: Teams authoring retrieval-augmented tool-chaining workflows repeatedly hit brittle tool schemas and unclear contracts between the agent and external tools. This quickstart provides a minimal, opinionated pattern for typed tool contracts (JSON Schema + examples), a small playbook that wires an agent to typed tools, and a golden-path smoke harness that runs a deterministic end-to-end scenario in CI so authors can validate regressions quickly.

What this PR does: - Adds a new quickstart at quickstarts/typed-tool-contract that contains a playbook.yaml, README, and sample index. - Adds a lightweight local runner (TS) that can deterministically replay a scenario with seeded embeddings and a fixed LLM stub. - Introduces JSON Schema tool contracts and example request/response fixtures for two sample tools (user_lookup and inventory_query). - Adds a CI smoke job (ci/smoke-goldenpath.yaml) that runs the playbook end-to-end and asserts structured outputs. - Adds docs page rag/typed-contracts.md that outlines the pattern and guidance for schema evolution and backward compatibility.

Commits (high level): - 1a2b3c4: scaffold quickstart layout and README - 5d6e7f8: add playbook.yaml and typed tool schemas - 9a0b1c2: implement local-replay TS runner and deterministic LLM stub - 3d4e5f6: add telemetry probes and golden-path CI job - 7a8b9c0: docs: add rag/typed-contracts.md and cross-links to console guides - f1e2d3c: polish: tweak timeouts and add more assertions for smoke test

Files changed (high level): - quickstarts/typed-tool-contract/README.md: quickstart overview, step-by-step authoring guide and expected outputs. - quickstarts/typed-tool-contract/playbook.yaml: compact playbook that wires prompt, retriever, and typed tools with contracts. - quickstarts/typed-tool-contract/fixtures/: example request/response JSON files used by the replay runner. - quickstarts/typed-tool-contract/local-replay.ts: deterministic runner for local dev and CI. - samples/tools/schemas/user_lookup.json & inventory_query.json: JSON Schemas for tool contracts plus examples. - docs/rag/typed-contracts.md: guidance on schema versioning and compatibility. - ci/smoke-goldenpath.yaml: CI job that boots the replay runner and asserts outputs. - examples/e2e/playwright/smoke.spec.ts: a small end-to-end smoke assertion harness for browser-based quickstart preview.

Notes on approach and reasoning: - We intentionally keep the playbook small and prefer explicit JSON Schemas over informal text docs. Schemas enable automatic structural validation and clearer migration paths when tool I/O changes. - The local replay runner uses a seeded PRNG and a deterministic LLM stub so CI failures reflect authoring regressions rather than model nondeterminism. - Telemetry probes emit a few structured events (playbook.start, tool.call, tool.response, playbook.assert) to demonstrate how Console dashboards can be wired to quickstarts.

Review conversation (selected): - Priya Nair (2026-02-16): "Nice pattern — can we shorten the default tool timeout in local-replay to 2s? Long timeouts make the CI job slow and mask downstream flakiness." - Maya Chen (2026-02-16): "Good call — lowered to 2s and pushed commit 3d4e5f6. Also added a retry wrapper around the inventory_query fixture so transient fetches are explicit in logs." - Owen Li (2026-02-17): "Suggest we add a brief migration note about schema bumping semantics in the docs page (major/minor mapping)." - Maya Chen (2026-02-17): "Added a 'Versioning and migrations' subsection in rag/typed-contracts.md with examples and recommended rollout steps (canary validation + fallback tool)." - Liam O'Connor (2026-02-18): "CI green on second run, smoke assertions look stable. Approving to merge."

CI and checks: - unit-tests: pass - lint: pass (TS/MD) - smoke-goldenpath (first run): failed due to flaky e2e fixture (timeout), rerun - smoke-goldenpath (rerun): pass - coverage: unchanged

Merge outcome: Squash-merged to main on 2026-02-18 by Maya Chen. Short squash commit message: "quickstarts: add typed-tool-contract playbook + smoke harness". Post-merge follow-ups: - ENG-4321: track expanding schemas to 5 more sample tools in a follow-up PR. - PM-88: create a short console walkthrough doc for the playbook and dashboard wiring.

How to try locally (summary): 1) cd quickstarts/typed-tool-contract 2) yarn && yarn start:replay --scenario=golden-path 3) open http://localhost:4000/preview to see structured events in the local trace UI (optional)

Risk and compatibility: low. This is additive quickstart content and does not change runtime code. The only CI change is a new smoke job which is gated and non-blocking for releases.

Related work: references quickstarts for replay, session-recorders, and schema-driven toolkits; links included in rag/typed-contracts.md.

If you want a quick demo, ping me and I can run the smoke harness in a live pairing session and show the Console telemetry wiring.
